### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, A17 was executed in every trace (200 of 200) near the end of the case (mean relative position about 0.95); in the later window, A17 is not observed in any trace. [OCC008, POS012]
- In the earlier window, A06 and A16 each appeared in about 40 in 100 traces, averaged about 2.1 occurrences per trace and were often repeated; in the later window, each is executed exactly once in every trace (participation 1.0, mean 1.0 occurrence, no repetition) at mean relative positions of about 0.96 and 0.94, i.e., at the end of the case. [OCC003, OCC007, POS004, POS011]
- In the later window, A06 and A16 co-occur in every trace (earlier about 40 in 100), with A06 before A16 in about 48 in 100 traces and A16 before A06 in about 52 in 100 — no fixed order between them — and each immediately follows the other in essentially all observed pairs; A04 and A10 now always precede both. [REL045, REL031, REL035, REL062, REL039, LAG022, LAG058]
- Successors changed: earlier, A10's only observed outgoing transition led to A17, and A04 led to A10 (about 52 in 100 of its outgoing transitions) or A17 (about 48 in 100); in the later window, A04 leads only to A10, A10 leads to A16 (about 52 in 100) or A06 (about 48 in 100), and A06 leads only to A16 while A16 leads only to A06. [DIR007, DIR004, DIR005, DIR011]
- A01, present in about 64 in 100 traces earlier, is not observed later; A07, not observed earlier, appears in about 68 in 100 later traces early in the case (mean relative position about 0.32) and leads to A03 or A04 about equally often. [OCC001, POS001, OCC004, POS005, DIR006]
- A02 rose from about 2.0 to about 9.0 occurrences per trace, with its successors shifting from A16/A06/A03/A04 to A15/A11/A14/A12; A14 and A15 rose from about 1.0 to about 4.5 occurrences per trace; A13 now leads only to A02 (earlier to A11 or A12 in about equal shares). [OCC002, DIR002, OCC005, OCC006, DIR009]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the end of the process was reorganised around A17, A06, A16, A10 and A04: A17, previously executed in every case as the final activity, is no longer observed, while A06 and A16 — previously optional, sometimes repeated activities in about 40 in 100 cases — now close every case, each exactly once, back-to-back in mixed order, reached from A10, which earlier led only to A17; A04 now always routes to A10 instead of sometimes to A17. [OCC008, POS012, OCC003, OCC007, REL045, DIR007, DIR004]

This hypothesis is shown directly and consistently by occurrence, positional, directional and pairwise-relation indicators that all describe the same end-stage behaviour, and the screening produced 171 qualifying items against fewer than 1 expected without change, so chance sampling cannot explain the item set as a whole. The evidence cannot rule out that the two windows sample different case mixes or variants rather than a modified process, and A17's zero participation strictly means only that it was not observed in the later sample. [OCC003, OCC007, POS004, POS011, REL045, DIR007]

Other differences: A01 (about 64 in 100 traces earlier) is not observed later; A07 is newly observed in about 68 in 100 later traces, early in the case, leading to A03 or A04 about equally often; A02 repeats about 9 times per trace instead of about 2, interleaved with A11–A15; A14 and A15 repeat about 4.5 times per trace instead of about 1; A13 now leads only to A02; A10's mean relative position moved earlier (about 0.95 to 0.81). [OCC001, POS001, OCC004, POS005, DIR006, OCC002, OCC005, OCC006, DIR009, POS007]
